detail.reasoning: For (1), the valid ordered draws are one red 1 with a blue 2, or one red 2 with a blue 1. These give \(2\cdot2\cdot2+4\cdot1\cdot2=16\) outcomes out of \(9^2=81\). For (2), symmetry gives \(P(B)=3/9\), and \(P(A\cap B)=(6\cdot3-2)/(9\cdot8)=2/9=P(A)P(B)\). Thus \(A\) and \(B\) are independent.
